capabilities: Create index notes in every folder listing its notes and subfolders
Update existing indexes automatically when notes are added, renamed, moved or deleted
Refresh a single folder's index with one command
Exclude folders and subfolders by path pattern
Sort index links naturally and in ascending or descending order
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Automatic creation of missing indexes is a setting that starts off; bulk creation confirms before touching folders.
motivation: The author wanted an index that only touches its own block, updates itself on note changes, creates nothing behind the user's back, and uses real Obsidian links.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to maintain an up-to-date index note per folder, so users must hand-write and update lists of links themselves.
summary: Folder index generator that keeps a note named _Index of <folder> in each folder, listing links to its notes and subfolders.
